description:
In this action-oriented project, the player takes on the role of a hero fighting off waves of fictional creatures. The game features five unique maps, each offering a separate survival challenge.  
  
The player's goal is to eliminate all enemies on the map within a limited time, using various weapons, tactics, and the environment. Each map has its own atmosphere and level of difficulty, requiring the player to adapt and think strategically.  
  
The gameplay is built around dynamic combat, tension, and a constant threat from enemies, creating an atmosphere of relentless survival.
